es: Integrar obligación, prohibición, lenguaje reglamentario, razón y excepciones para redactar una normativa breve y un aviso cercano que la explique a los vecinos.

teaching.en: This policy sets out the rules for using the shared garden, and it will take effect on the first of May for every plot holder.
teaching.es: Esta normativa establece las reglas para usar el huerto compartido y entrará en vigor el uno de mayo para todos los titulares de parcela.
teaching.explanationEs: Policy: el documento que reúne las normas; se redacta en presente formal. Take effect: entrar en vigor en una fecha.
segments: This policy sets out the rules for using the shared garden, and it
will take effect on the first of May for every plot holder.
teaching.audioText: This policy sets out the rules for using the shared garden, and it will take effect on the first of May for every plot holder.

teaching.en: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds, and any plot left untended for two months may be offered to someone on the waiting list.
teaching.es: Cada socio mantendrá su parcela libre de malas hierbas, y toda parcela abandonada durante dos meses podrá ofrecerse a alguien de la lista de espera.
teaching.explanationEs: Each + singular + shall + verbo base: obligación formal y directa; each no lleva -s.
segments: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds, and any plot left
untended for two months may be offered to someone on the waiting list.
teaching.audioText: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds, and any plot left untended for two months may be offered to someone on the waiting list.

teaching.en: Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use, and members who damage them will be held accountable for the repair.
teaching.es: Las herramientas se limpiarán y se devolverán al cobertizo después de usarse, y los socios que las dañen responderán de la reparación.
teaching.explanationEs: Are to be + participio: orden impersonal de reglamento. Be held accountable: asumir las consecuencias de algo.
segments: Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use,
and members who damage them will be held accountable for the repair.
teaching.audioText: Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use, and members who damage them will be held accountable for the repair.

teaching.en: Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly, in the interest of all the neighbours who help to make it.
teaching.es: Se podrá llevar compost a casa, siempre que se reparta de forma justa, en interés de todos los vecinos que ayudan a hacerlo.
teaching.explanationEs: May be + participio con una condición: permiso formal con límite. In the interest of + personas: en beneficio de ellas.
segments: Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly, in
the interest of all the neighbours who help to make it.
teaching.audioText: Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly, in the interest of all the neighbours who help to make it.

teaching.en: The committee has the paths cleaned by a company, but each member is responsible for their own plot and for watering it on their rota day.
teaching.es: El comité hace limpiar los caminos a una empresa, pero cada socio es responsable de su parcela y de regarla el día que le toque en el turno.
teaching.explanationEs: Have + objeto + participio: se encarga a un tercero. Responsible for: quien responde de la tarea. Rota: el turno que reparte las tareas.
segments: The committee has the paths cleaned by a company, but each member is
responsible for their own plot and for watering it on their rota day.
teaching.audioText: The committee has the paths cleaned by a company, but each member is responsible for their own plot and for watering it on their rota day.

teaching.en: Dear neighbours, this public notice explains why the garden will be closed on Mondays, and what each of you needs to do about it.
teaching.es: Estimados vecinos, este aviso público explica por qué el huerto cerrará los lunes y qué debe hacer cada uno de ustedes al respecto.
teaching.explanationEs: Un aviso abre con el destinatario y da pronto el motivo, en tono cercano; el mismo contenido que la normativa, dicho de otro modo.
segments: Dear neighbours, this public notice explains why the garden will be closed
on Mondays, and what each of you needs to do about it.
teaching.audioText: Dear neighbours, this public notice explains why the garden will be closed on Mondays, and what each of you needs to do about it.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal de la regla para una normativa.

choices.text: Each member will keep the shed locked, OK?
Every member keeps to lock the shed.
Each member shall keep the shed locked.

feedback.es: Each member shall + verbo base es la fórmula de obligación de una normativa; las otras dos son informales o incorrectas.

hint.es: Busca el modal formal y el sujeto en singular.

origin.text: The committee is drafting its policy for the shared garden. The informal rule on the wall says: please lock the shed when you leave.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los socios son responsables de regar su propia parcela.»

feedback.es: Responsible for + -ing indica quién responde de una tarea.

hint.es: Es el adjetivo que significa «responsable» y se une a for.

origin.text: Nobody else will water your plot for you. Members are ___ for watering their own plots.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Estimados vecinos, les escribimos para informarles del cambio.»

answer.text: Dear neighbours, we are writing to inform you of the change
accepted: Dear neighbours, we are writing to inform you of the change
Dear neighbours, we are writing to inform you about the change

feedback.es: El aviso abre con el destinatario y expresa la finalidad con to + verbo: to inform.

hint.es: Tras el saludo, la finalidad va con to + verbo.

prompt.es: Escucha el aviso y elige por qué cerrarán el huerto los lunes.

choices.text: To let the soil rest.
To repair the shed.
To stop neighbours from visiting.

feedback.es: La razón del cierre es que la tierra necesita descansar; los socios aún pueden recoger herramientas con permiso.

origin.audio: Good evening, neighbours. From next month, the garden will be closed on Mondays, because the soil needs to rest. The decision was taken by the committee in the interest of all members, and it will take effect on the first of May. Members may still collect their tools on Mondays, provided that they ask the rota manager first. Anyone who leaves a plot untended for two months will be held accountable, and the plot may be offered to someone on the waiting list. If you have questions, please come to the meeting on Saturday morning.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su tono o su función.

pairs: Tools are to be returned to the shed.
Please return the tools to the shed.
Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain…
The new rule will take effect in May.

feedback.es: Are to be es formal y please suena cercano; Dear neighbours abre un aviso y take effect fija cuándo empieza a valer la norma.

pairs: Tools are to be returned to the shed.
Please return the tools to the shed.
Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain…
The new rule will take effect in May.

choices.text: Defensive: it blames families for the long waiting list.
Understanding but firm: it explains a hard decision.
Apologetic: it offers to cancel the decision if residents object.

feedback.es: Reconoce que la decisión será dura, pero la mantiene y la explica con la lista de espera: comprensivo y firme.

origin.text: Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain why plots will no longer be handed down within a family. The committee knows this will be hard for some of you, but the waiting list now has forty names, and it would not be fair to make them wait for ever. We hope you will understand, and we are ready to talk to anyone who is affected.

prompt.es: Escucha la reunión y elige cuál es la razón de la nueva normativa.

choices.text: To reduce the cost of looking after the garden.
To give large families more space.
To share plots more fairly.

feedback.es: La razón es la justicia: como la lista de espera es larga, se limita una parcela por familia.

origin.audio: Ms Ortiz, from the garden committee, explained the new policy. Our rationale is simple, she said: plots should be shared fairly. The waiting list is long, so each family will be limited to one plot. Mr Bell, a member with three children, replied that he understood the aim, but that the impact on large families would be serious. Ms Ortiz answered that the committee would listen to any family that felt treated unfairly, but she would not promise an exception.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez: ¿qué da a entender la Sra. Ortiz al no prometer una excepción?

choices.text: She will listen, but does not want to raise false hopes.
She understands the complaint and is privately planning to change the rule.
She will make exceptions once the waiting list is shorter.

feedback.es: Se ofrece a escuchar pero no promete nada: no quiere crear falsas esperanzas, sin cerrar la puerta a hablar.

origin.audio: Ms Ortiz, from the garden committee, explained the new policy. Our rationale is simple, she said: plots should be shared fairly. The waiting list is long, so each family will be limited to one plot. Mr Bell, a member with three children, replied that he understood the aim, but that the impact on large families would be serious. Ms Ortiz answered that the committee would listen to any family that felt treated unfairly, but she would not promise an exception.

prompt.es: Completa: «Quien deje la puerta abierta responderá de cualquier daño a los cultivos.»

feedback.es: Be held accountable for significa responder de algo, con las consecuencias que eso implique.

origin.text: Please close the gate behind you. Anyone who leaves it open will be held ___ for any damage to the crops.

prompt.es: Escribe una normativa breve y un aviso para los vecinos.

answer.text: Policy: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds. Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use, and members who damage them will be held accountable. Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly. Dogs may not enter the garden, except for guide dogs. Notice: Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain the new garden policy, which will take effect in May. The rules are intended to keep the garden nice for everybody, given that so many families share it. Each member is responsible for watering on their rota day, but you don't have to work on other days. In order to keep the tools safe, please return them to the shed. We know that change is never easy, and we thank you for your understanding. If you have any questions, please speak to the committee on Saturday morning.
accepted: Policy: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds. Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use, and members who damage them will be held accountable. Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly. Dogs may not enter the garden, except for guide dogs. Notice: Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain the new garden policy, which will take effect in May. The rules are intended to keep the garden nice for everybody, given that so many families share it. Each member is responsible for watering on their rota day, but you don't have to work on other days. In order to keep the tools safe, please return them to the shed. We know that change is never easy, and we thank you for your understanding. If you have any questions, please speak to the committee on Saturday morning.

Policy: Every member shall pay a small fee each year. Plots must be kept tidy, and weeds are to be removed every week. Fires may not be lit in the garden, apart from the barbecue area. Notice: Dear neighbours, from May the garden has a new policy. Its rationale is fairness, since a long waiting list means that nobody should leave a plot empty. Members are responsible for telling the committee if they cannot look after their plot, and anyone who ignores a rule will be held accountable. You are permitted to bring friends on Sundays, provided that they follow the rules. Please speak to us if anything is unclear. Thank you for your help, and we hope you will enjoy the garden.

feedback.es: Un buen texto separa dos registros: normas formales e impersonales y un aviso cercano que saluda, da la razón y dice a quién acudir.

origin.text: Eres secretario o secretaria del comité de un huerto comunitario. Escribe en inglés, en un solo texto de 140 a 200 palabras: (1) varias normas formales (shall, may not, are to be) con una excepción o condición y (2) un aviso cercano para los vecinos (Dear neighbours) que explique la razón de la normativa.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿qué actitud muestra el socio al final?

choices.text: He is persuaded, although he still thinks the notice was late.
He stays unhappy despite the explanation.
He is annoyed with the chair personally, not with the rule.

feedback.es: La presidenta da sus razones, pero el socio «no parecía convencido»: sigue sin aceptar la explicación.

origin.audio: After the meeting, a member complained that the new rule had been announced too late. The chair agreed that the notice could have gone out earlier, but she pointed out that the rule takes effect only in May, which gives everyone time to prepare. She added that a notice that explains the reason is always better than one that simply gives an order. The member did not look convinced.

prompt.es: Lee el correo: ¿qué actitud muestra el comité ante las críticas?

choices.text: It listens to objections and promises to change the limit.
It expects objections and has prepared an alternative limit.
It accepts objections, but only through a formal route.

feedback.es: Invita a presentar la objeción por escrito antes de fin de mes: acepta críticas, pero por un cauce formal.

origin.text: To all plot holders: with effect from the first of May, compost may only be taken home in the interest of fair sharing, and each household may take no more than two bags a week. The committee has not taken this decision lightly. If you think the limit is unfair, please put your case in writing before the end of the month.

prompt.es: Escribe una frase amable pidiendo devolver las herramientas.

answer.text: We kindly ask neighbours to return the tools to the shed.
accepted: We kindly ask neighbours to return the tools to the shed.
Please return the tools to the shed.
Neighbours are kindly asked to return the tools to the shed.
We ask neighbours to return the tools to the shed.
We kindly ask you to return the tools to the shed.
Please remember to return the tools to the shed.

feedback.es: We kindly ask… to + verbo convierte una orden formal en una petición cercana.

origin.text: Escribe una frase de aviso amable: pedir a los vecinos que devuelvan las herramientas al cobertizo.
